summary: Official Nacala municipal and ADE/MOZGIS sources were checked in English and Portuguese. Historical local cadastral evidence exists, but no current safe anonymous Nacala parcel ID plus geometry response was verified.
queryOutcomes: Both first-party discovery queries are recorded in the city record. They identified the official municipal portal, ADE/MOZGIS, and historical evidence of a Nacala municipal cadastre.
requestOutcomes: Municipal and ADE pages returned HTTP 200. MOZGIS REST directory and a public Matola cadastral layer returned HTTP 200. The exact WUP-point query against that Matola layer returned an empty FeatureCollection; this was not treated as a citywide Nacala absence.
scopeLimits: No current citywide Nacala parcel coverage verified
Matola cadastral service distinguished from Nacala local custodian
No credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS-disable exception used
uncertainty: Nacala's municipal cadastre may be non-public, interactive or unpublished. Route-specific empty results and missing service names do not prove absence.
